🇺🇸 Elon Musk is helping America advance through bold innovation and massive job creation across his companies:

•  Tesla: ~130,000+ direct US jobs in factories (Fremont, Austin, etc.), EVs, energy storage — plus hundreds of thousands more via suppliers, driving American manufacturing, exports, and cleaner transport.
•  SpaceX: ~20,000+ high-tech aerospace jobs, reusable rockets, Starlink for rural/disaster connectivity, NASA contracts securing US space leadership. Thousands of supplier roles in engineering & materials.
•  The Boring Company: Building underground tunnel systems (Vegas Loop, Music City Loop in Nashville) to solve urban traffic congestion with fast, electric vehicle shuttles. Direct employment in the hundreds (engineers, operators, tunnel crews) with significant indirect jobs through construction suppliers, electricians, mechanics, and local partners. Projects like Prufrock machines speed up infrastructure, create economic growth in growing cities, reduce emissions, and ease congestion without massive taxpayer burdens. boringcompany.com 
•  xAI, Neuralink & more: Advancing AI for scientific discovery and brain tech for medical breakthroughs — attracting top talent and spurring US tech dominance.
Total impact: Musk’s companies directly employ ~140,000–150,000+ people (mostly in America) and support hundreds of thousands of indirect jobs through vast supply chains, contractors, and related industries. Billions in US wages, R&D, and domestic manufacturing. electrek.co 
This is real advancement: sustainable energy, space leadership, better cities, connectivity, and future tech — all while employing Americans at scale. Builders are moving the country forward.
